info.name: TicketForge – Event & Ticket Reservation API
info.description:
End-to-end suite: auth/RBAC, multi-tenant isolation, Redis caching, concurrent booking races, async payments and expired holds.

Set `baseUrl` (collection variable) to your deployment, then run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner.

exec: pm.test('DB and Redis are up', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.db).to.equal('up'); pm.expect(b.redis).to.equal('up'); });

item.name: Create event – sales cut-off after start → 400
Create event with VIP + GA tiers (published)

exec: pm.test('Two tiers with correct inventory', () => { pm.expect(e.tiers).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(e.tiers[0].available).to.equal(4); pm.expect(e.tiers[1].available).to.equal(10); });

item.name: Tenant isolation – organizer 2 cannot edit organizer 1 event → 403
Get event again → served from Redis (X-Cache: HIT)

exec: pm.test('Cache reflects the latest edit', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().event.venue).to.equal('Test Arena, Hall 2'));

item.name: Too many tickets in one order → 422

exec: pm.test('Order is pending with a 10-minute hold', () => { pm.expect(o.status).to.equal('pending'); pm.expect(o.secondsRemaining).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(o.secondsRemaining).to.be.at.most(600); });
pm.test('Seat is held and priced', () => { pm.expect(o.items[0].status).to.equal('held'); pm.expect(o.totalCents).to.equal(250000); });

item.name: Attendee B tries the same seat → 409
Attendee A second hold on same event → 409

exec: pm.test('VIP shows 1 held, 3 available', () => { const t = pm.response.json().event.tiers[0]; pm.expect(t.held).to.equal(1); pm.expect(t.available).to.equal(3); });

item.name: Order released by the worker is expired
Attendee B holds seat 3, then cancels

exec: pm.test('Cancelled + seat available', () => { const o = pm.response.json().order; pm.expect(o.status).to.equal('cancelled'); pm.expect(o.items[0].status).to.equal('available'); });
pm.test('Revenue includes the paid VIP order', () => pm.expect(b.totals.revenueCents).to.be.at.least(250000));
